title: USDA Crop Sequence Boundaries
description: Crop Sequence Boundaries (CSB) is a fully synthetic vector dataset of approximately 16.2 million agricultural field boundaries across the contiguous United States, derived from stacked USDA Cropland Data Layers. It captures estimated field extents, acreage, and crop rotation history (2016–2023), with adjacent same-crop polygons dissolved. Converted to fiboa-compliant GeoParquet format from USDA NASS source data.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for USDA CSB

Crop Sequence Boundaries (CSB) is a vector-based geospatial dataset which are fully synthetic representations of 
agricultural fields, their acreage, and cropping rotation history. These new data are primarily derived from a 
historical stack of Cropland Data Layers over a set time frame based on an algorithm of geospatial functions. 
It was developed in cooperation with the Economic Research Service.

[See metadata](https://www.nass.usda.gov/Research_and_Science/Crop-Sequence-Boundaries/metadata_Crop-Sequence-Boundaries-2023.htm)

Provides 16.194.865 field boundaries, based on data taken from taken from USDA CSB.
Adjacent polygons with equal crops for 2023 have been merged ("dissolved")
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from USDA.

Available free for download at https://www.nass.usda.gov/Research_and_Science/Crop-Sequence-Boundaries/. 
Github repository containing the code used to create the Crop Sequence Boundaries (CSB) can be found at https://github.com/USDA-REE-NASS/crop-sequence-boundaries/tree/main/csb-project.

- **Source Data Provider:** [USDA](https://www.nass.usda.gov/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** The USDA NASS Crop Sequence Boundaries and the data offered at https://www.nass.usda.gov/Research_and_Science/Crop-Sequence-Boundaries are provided to the public as is and are considered public domain and free to redistribute. Users of the Crop Sequence Boundaries (CSB) are solely responsible for interpretations made from these products. The CSB are provided 'as is' and the USDA NASS does not warrant results you may obtain using the data. Contact our staff at (SM.NASS.RDD.GIB@usda.gov) if technical questions arise.
- **Projection:** EPSG:5070 ("Albers Conical Equal Area as used by mrlc.gov (NLCD)") [info](https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/59673/calculating-points-in-the-usdas-cropland-data-layer-coordinate-system)

## Columns

| Property                    | **Data Type** | Description |
|-----------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                          | string        |             |
| crop:code                   | string        |             |
| crop:name                   | string        |             |
| administrative_area_level_2 | string        |             |
| determination_datetime      | timestamp     |             |
| crop:code_list              | string        |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-25 from https://www.nass.usda.gov/Research_and_Science/Crop-Sequence-Boundaries/datasets/NationalCSB_2016-2023_rev23.zip .
- Adjacent polygons with same 2023-crop have been merged ("dissolved")
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
